scope_statement: This change enforces orders to be split by notional when liquidation is triggered.
prep_snippet_requirements_note: Epic has Confluence links only; no Yogi keys required for prep gold.
checklist_notes:
Good:
  - great focus on functional implementation, how the system works dynamically
  - examples of use as > comments
  - short and concise

  Bad: overall epic name is referenced in each scenario for some reason instead of actual yogi-tags/reqs
reference_checklist:
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check default max liquidation qty for CFD_FOREX_OTC
>all instruments with CFD_FOREX_OTC subtype should have default max liquidation qty = 200
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check default max liquidation qty for CFD_FOREX_DMA
>all instruments with CFD_FOREX_DMA subtype should have default max liquidation qty = 20 000 000
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check there is no default max liquidation qty for CFD/CFD_STOCK
>No defaults for CFD and CFD Stock -> they shouldn't be liquidated in chunks -> the value is empty 
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Change max liquidation qty for CFD/CFD_STOCK/CFD_FOREX
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check that MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY used on liquidation
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check that Position with qty ≤ max liquidation qty not split
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check Liquidation when MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY is not set
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Orders with qty > max liquidation qty are allowed
>User can open a position with quantity greater than the instrument’s MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY (e.g. 500 when max = 200). No validation error
>Opening/closing orders are not rejected or limited by MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY; restriction applies only during liquidation
>If MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY is not set, full position is closed with one order (no chunking)
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Orders sent without waiting for fill and sent simultaneously
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Liquidation is completed only after all liq orders are completed
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Liquidation waits for trading hours
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check liquidation status in review when one order is not executed
- Liquidation in chunks for CFDs - Check Liquidation retries
